outputIntent: Explain one fictional product task or state transition through a credible original interface whose selected state, data, and workflow agree.
positioning: Not decorative dashboard art or a clone of a real SaaS product; it is functional visual evidence with one clearly explained user outcome.
contentSchema: one product goal and user task

layoutFamilies.topology: stable shell frames one dominant working canvas; navigation recedes; one focal feature expands with two supporting evidence panels
layoutFamilies.readingPath: task context -> selected feature -> evidence -> outcome
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: front orthographic interface view with a subtle feature-plane lift, never a tilted device mockup
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one shell, one focal feature, two evidence panels, one outcome region

layoutFamilies.topology: three clearly distinct states share one component geometry along a left-to-right transition; result metric anchors the final state
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: matched component scale and fixed shell camera across all states
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one shell, three states, one transition path, one result metric

physicalVisualSystem.material: clean light UI surfaces with restrained frosted layers, precise 8pt spacing rhythm, subtle elevation, and realistic component density
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: neutral product-surface illumination with shallow soft shadows; no neon glow or glossy device reflections
physicalVisualSystem.color: warm white and cool grey base, one cobalt product accent, one bounded status color only where semantically required
physicalVisualSystem.typography: short exact Chinese UI labels in a consistent product sans hierarchy; reserve longer copy for deterministic overlays

forbiddenElements: placeholder bars with no explanatory job
unwhitelisted ticks timestamps or step numbers
qcAssertions: the user task is visible without narration
state transition and result metric agree
component tokens and shell stay internally consistent
important controls and evidence remain above the subtitle-safe band
